about: Reviewed decisions for the POI audit (2026-11-15). scripts/audit_poi.py proposes, a person decides here, scripts/poi_reconcile.py applies. Nothing is deleted from data/raw: a merged record stays there and in data/audit, and is only left out of the map layer, with merged_into pointing at the record that keeps it.

duplicates.name: 絵馬展示資料館
duplicates.evidence: Two OSM museum nodes 3 m apart, added by the same edit on 2019-06-29 (nodes 6578053381 and 6578080296); the second carries operator=三宅八幡神社. One museum exists there.
duplicates.keep_reason: keeps the node with the operator tag

duplicates.name: Best Breakfast Point
duplicates.evidence: Four viewpoint nodes within 7 m, all added on 2018-03-25 in two batches (5502313424-25 and 5502354121/5502354221); names 'Best Breakfast Point' (x2) and 'Breakfast Point', English 'Best Breakfast Point' and the misspelling 'Beat Breakfast Point'. The same viewpoint entered twice.
duplicates.keep_reason: keeps the first node, whose name is the one used most

duplicates.name: 黄桜記念館
duplicates.evidence: Two OSM museum nodes 14 m apart with the same name: the older one (2022, operator カッパカントリー, brewery=yes) and one added on 2024-12-28 with no other tags. One memorial hall exists at Kizakura Kappa Country.
duplicates.keep_reason: keeps the older node with more tags

possible_duplicates.name: おもかる石
possible_duplicates.note: 1 m apart, same tags. At Fushimi Inari's Okusha Hohaisho there is a pair of these stone lanterns (left and right), so these may be the two stones. Kept both; needs a site check.

possible_duplicates.name: 石塀小路
possible_duplicates.note: One lane, two points 134 m apart (2017 and 2018 edits). Probably the same lane marked twice, at different spots. Kept both; needs a decision on which point represents the lane.

possible_duplicates.name: 保津峡展望台
possible_duplicates.note: Same name, 341 m apart. Could be two different viewpoints over the gorge. Kept both.

related_groups.name: 股のぞき台 (傘松公園)
related_groups.note: A row of separate 'look between your legs' platforms at Kasamatsu Park; each is a real platform. Kept, grouped.

related_groups.name: 股のぞき台 (天橋立ビューランド)
related_groups.note: Several separate platforms at Amanohashidate View Land within about 50 m, mapped in one edit on 2019-05-02. Kept, grouped.

related_groups.name: 宇治橋
related_groups.note: The Uji Bridge and its 三の間 (the old and the present one). Different features of the same bridge.

distinct.name: 西から見た二条城東南隅櫓の眺め
distinct.note: Two different viewpoints 387 m apart: their English names describe different views (A00078: from the ruins of the donjon; A00488: the southeast corner turret from the west). A00078's Japanese name looks copied from A00488's; it is left as the source has it and flagged here.

distinct.name: KYOTO SAMURAI NINJA MUSEUM
distinct.note: Different addresses (堀之上町 109 and 東大文字町 292-4): two premises.

dashboard_records_inside_new_sites: Filled in by scripts/poi_reconcile.py from data/audit/poi_audit.json: dashboard records that are part of a CSV site (for example the Nijo Castle viewpoints) get parent_id.
